description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A radiologist needs a Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) image to visualize vascular calcifications and subtle fracture lines. Configure the Axial view to use 'MaxIP' (Maximum Intensity Projection) mode with a slab thickness of at least 15 slices. Export the resulting Axial view as a PNG image to /home/ga/Documents/axial_mip.png. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
